dx_dlbcl_gcb.quote: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, NOS, germinal-center B-cell-like (Hans algorithm), primary right cervical nodal disease (levels II-III).

stage_i.quote: Ann Arbor / Lugano Stage IA (A: no B symptoms; no E). Disease is confined to one nodal region on one side of the diaphragm (right cervical levels II-III, contiguous on PET-CT).

stage_nonbulky_no_b.quote: Largest node 3.1 cm, so not bulky by either the 7.5 cm or the 10 cm threshold.

stage_pet_no_marrow_biopsy.quote: Bone marrow biopsy is not needed: PET-CT showed no marrow uptake and marrow status would not change management.

mn_overstaged.quote: Ann Arbor / Lugano Stage IA (A: no B symptoms; no E).

mol_not_de_not_dh.quote: FISH on the 2026-09-04 biopsy (200 nuclei, addendum 2026-09-15) is negative for MYC (8q24), BCL2 (18q21) and BCL6 (3q27) rearrangements, so this is not double-hit or triple-hit lymphoma. Not double-expressor: MYC IHC 15% (threshold 40%) and BCL2 IHC 30% (threshold 50%).

mn_calls_double_hit.quote: so this is not double-hit or triple-hit lymphoma.

mn_calls_double_expressor.quote: Not double-expressor: MYC IHC 15% (threshold 40%) and BCL2 IHC 30% (threshold 50%).

prog_ipi_low.quote: Favorable. IPI 0 (age 45, LDH 190 U/L with ULN 225, ECOG 0, stage I).

prog_cns_ipi_low.quote: CNS-IPI 0: age 60 or younger, normal LDH, ECOG 0-1, stage I, no kidney or adrenal involvement, no more than one extranodal site, no marrow involvement.

tx_curative_rchop.quote: Decision: R-CHOP-21 for 6 cycles at full dose, with no involved-site radiotherapy if the end-of-treatment PET-CT is Deauville 1-3.

tx_flyer_4rchop_2r.quote: Decision: R-CHOP-21 for 6 cycles at full dose, with no involved-site radiotherapy

tx_no_rt_goals.quote: she has explicitly declined neck radiation, and her sister's hypothyroidism after neck RT makes that concern real

tx_alternatives.quote: Fallback if she prefers fewer cycles: R-CHOP-21 x 4 followed by thyroid-sparing IMRT 20-30 Gy to the involved neck, which is also guideline-concordant.

mn_six_cycles.quote: Decision: R-CHOP-21 for 6 cycles at full dose, with no involved-site radiotherapy

mn_da_epoch.quote: The biology does not call for a dose-adjusted or intensified regimen (no DA-EPOCH-R)

mn_observation_or_rt_alone.quote: Decision: R-CHOP-21 for 6 cycles at full dose

cns_low_no_prophylaxis.quote: Low. CNS-IPI 0: age 60 or younger, normal LDH, ECOG 0-1, stage I, no kidney or adrenal involvement... No CNS prophylaxis: no intrathecal methotrexate and no high-dose methotrexate.

mn_mandates_cns_prophylaxis.quote: No CNS prophylaxis: no intrathecal methotrexate and no high-dose methotrexate.

resp_eot_pet_lugano.quote: End-of-treatment FDG-PET-CT about 3-5 weeks after cycle 6, scored on the Deauville 5-point scale (Lugano 2014). Deauville 1-3 is complete metabolic response: no RT, move to surveillance.

resp_interim_pet.quote: Interim PET is not required for this plan, and an interim PET will not be used to shorten therapy.

work_pregnancy_test.quote: (1) Serum hCG before cycle 1 (none documented); repeat before any RT and whenever there is doubt.

work_hbv_reviewed.quote: Hepatitis: HBsAg and anti-HBc negative with anti-HBs positive means no antiviral prophylaxis and no HBV DNA monitoring.

work_echo_reviewed.quote: Echo (LVEF 63%, GLS -21%) is adequate for anthracycline.

sup_stop_coc_switch.quote: Stop the combined oral contraceptive now. ... Bridge today with a progestin-only method (norethindrone pill, acceptable with aura) plus condoms, then place an LNG-IUD before cycle 1

sup_coc_reason.quote: Estrogen-containing contraception is contraindicated with migraine with aura (CDC US MEC category 4, ischemic stroke risk); she had aura episodes this month. Estrogen also adds VTE risk with lymphoma and chemotherapy.

sup_fertility_counselling.quote: refer to reproductive endocrinology before cycle 1. Check AMH and antral follicle count... Counsel that cyclophosphamide-based therapy at age 45 carries a substantial risk of premature ovarian insufficiency.

fit_goals.quote: Fit for full-intensity curative therapy: ECOG 0, normal renal, hepatic, marrow and cardiac function, and no significant comorbidity.
